name: @tabnas/hoover
description: A plugin for the Tabnas parser engine (https://github.com/tabnas/parser) that adds string hoovering: unquoted values with internal spaces.
author: Richard Rodger (http://richardrodger.com)

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist dist-test node_modules yarn.lock package-lock.json
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm run build && npm test
scripts.repo-tag: REPO_VERSION=`node -e "console.log(require('./package').version)"` && echo TAG: ts/v$REPO_VERSION && git commit -a -m v$REPO_VERSION && git push && git tag ts/v$REPO_VERSION && git push origin ts/v$REPO_VERSION;
scripts.repo-publish: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-publish-quick
scripts.repo-publish-quick: npm run build && npm run test && npm run repo-tag
scripts.repo-stage: npm run clean && npm i && npm run repo-stage-quick
scripts.repo-stage-quick: npm run build && npm run test && npm stage publish
